errors.text: The proposed substitution targets tungsten, but the Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr baseline contains no tungsten.
The baseline is incorrectly described as prone to a continuous ordered B2 matrix; the target baseline is a single-phase BCC alloy.
The cited evidence does not directly establish that V addition or Ti/Zr adjustment suppresses B2 ordering or improves ductility in Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr.
The baseline ductility is substantially misrepresented: its room-temperature compression fracture strain is about 11.6%, not below 2%.
